channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 7 Nov: Harare partly cloudy · high 33° / low 20°
item.description: Harare: high 33°, low 20° (partly cloudy) · Bulawayo: high 34°, low 22° (light drizzle) · Mutare: high 33°, low 19° (partly cloudy) · Gweru: high 34°, low 22° (drizzle) · Masvingo: high 36°, low 23° (drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 38°, low 27° (partly cloudy) Tsumo yezuva: Vasikana kudada kudada zvenyu, tichaonana magaro pakuyambuka. (Reject people in good times and you will need them in hard ones.) #Zimbabwe #Weather #ZimbabweWeather #ZimbabweNews
